summary.text: On the jungle plane of Ixalan, the Sun Empire, the River Heralds, the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition's pirates all race to the golden city of Orazca, where the Immortal Sun lies hidden.

The story follows Jace Beleren, stranded without his memories until Vraska's crew finds him, and Huatli, whose planeswalker spark ignites in a fight with Angrath and who is promised the title of warrior-poet if she finds Orazca.
Vraska has been hired by Nicol Bolas to retrieve an item from the city, and at Orazca Tezzeret seizes the Immortal Sun through a planar portal, which removes it from Ixalan.
